production_claim_policy: Never promote forecast, modelled, calculated or estimated values to measured or verified without evidence.
reportability_policy: REPORTABLE means provenance, timestamp, coordinate, unit, methodology, quality and reconciliation rules pass; REPORTABLE does not mean MEASURED, VERIFIED or ANCHORED.
live_feed_policy: Only genuine provider transport capabilities may be labelled PUSH_STREAM. HTTP retrieval remains POLLING_API; retrospective datasets remain ARCHIVE_QUERY. Video transport is separately classified as WebRTC, SRT, RTSP bridge or archived media and must not be conflated with environmental sensor transport.
video_evidence_policy: Video is corroborating provenance evidence, not standalone proof of physical harvest, quantity, water quality or compliance. Cryptographic integrity is established through segment hashes, linked manifests and an evidence root; verification requires independent DMRV reconciliation.
